chapter: Brass bands, funerals and working conditions
title: Funeral marches, street parades and brass band instrumentation
summary: Slow dirges were doubled up in tempo after the funeral. He describes club parades with umbrellas, the instruments in marching bands, and the doubling between brass and dance bands.
